name: Your Company
tagline: A plumber or electrician at your door within the hour
niche: Handyman service: plumbing, electrics and small repairs across Tashkent

listing.description: A website for handyman, plumbing, electrical and appliance repair services. A bold yellow service look: a live job tracker on the first screen, a “from” price list with icons and a call button always within reach.

seo.title: Your Company — plumber and electrician in Tashkent within an hour
seo.description: Call a handyman to your home in Tashkent around the clock: leaks, blockages, sockets, breakers, taps and light fittings. Price agreed before work starts, 6-month guarantee.
seo.answer: Your Company is a home repair service in Tashkent: a plumber or electrician arrives in about 60 minutes, day or night. A call-out is 50,000 sum, replacing a tap starts at 120,000 sum, fitting a socket at 60,000 sum. The price is agreed before work starts and every job carries a 6-month guarantee. Call +998 71 200-00-81 or write on Telegram.

sections.title: A pro at your door in an hour
sections.eyebrow: Day and night · all of Tashkent
sections.subtitle: A dripping tap, a tripped breaker, a dead socket — leave a request and a vetted pro arrives with tools and parts. We quote the price before any work starts.

sections.label: Prices
sections.title: What we fix and what it costs
sections.intro: Prices cover the pro’s labour. Parts at shop receipt or your own. Call-out is 50,000 sum, free for jobs over 200,000 sum.

items.title: Fixing a leak
items.text: We find the cause and replace the gasket, fitting or section of pipe.

items.title: Unblocking a drain
items.text: Sink, bath or toilet — by cable or water jetting.

items.title: Replacing a tap
items.text: We remove the old one, fit the new one and check the supply lines.

items.title: Installing a water heater
items.text: Mounting, connecting to water and power, first start-up.

items.title: Socket or switch
items.text: Fitting, replacing or moving a point.

items.title: Breaker keeps tripping
items.text: We trace the short or overload and replace the breaker.

items.title: Washing machine
items.text: Connecting to water and drain, leak check.

items.title: Request
items.text: Call or message on Telegram. Send a photo and we will quote more precisely.

items.title: Pro on the way
items.text: The nearest free pro sets off; you see their name and arrival time.

items.title: Price up front
items.text: On site the pro inspects and names the total. You agree — we start.

items.title: Hand-over and guarantee
items.text: We test it with you, clean up after ourselves and issue a 6-month guarantee slip.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Pros you are happy to let into your home
sections.text: Every pro goes through an interview, a document check and a trial job with a senior. They arrive in uniform with shoe covers and a vacuum. If something breaks again within six months of the repair, we fix it free of charge.

items.quote: A hose burst under the sink at night. The pro was there in 40 minutes, shut it off, replaced it and even mopped the floor.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: They told us the price up front and it did not go up. That is what matters to us.
items.author: Sardor

items.quote: We took the office plan — the electrician comes on schedule and we have forgotten about tripped breakers.
items.author: Kamola

items.q: How fast will a pro arrive?
items.a: About 60 minutes anywhere in Tashkent. Nights and holidays too, with no rush surcharge.
50,000 sum. If you order work over 200,000 sum, the call-out is free.

items.q: What if the price changes on site?
items.a: The pro names the total before starting. The price does not change without your agreement.
The pro carries common parts and gives you the receipt. Your own parts are fine too.
Cash, Uzcard or Humo card, or bank transfer. Companies can pay by invoice.

sections.label: Call
sections.title: Tell us what happened
sections.text: Call or write on Telegram: your address, what broke and a photo if you have one. We call back within five minutes with the pro’s arrival time.
